metrics.accuracy_method: Holdout split (test_size=0.2, random_state=42); accuracy_score on y_test
metrics.model_rationale: Random Forest chosen for highest accuracy and robustness on mixed/binary features; also provides feature importances for explainability.
knn_svm_notes: KNN can underperform without feature scaling and with many binary indicators; consider scaling and tuning n_neighbors/weights.
SVM (RBF) is sensitive to feature scales; with binary-heavy features, a linear kernel or scaling often works better.
